'''''Alcantarea''''' is a genus of flowering plants in the [[Bromeliaceae]] family.<ref name=POWO>{{cite taxon |POWO |id=30103488-2 |title=''Alcantarea'' (É.Morren ex Mez) Harms |access-date=June 26, 2026}}</ref><ref name=COL>{{Catalogue of Life |id= 8VTJD |title=''Alcantarea'' (É.Morren ex Mez) Harms |access-date=June 26, 2026}}</ref> It is named for Dom Pedro d'Alcântara, second Emperor of Brazil.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://bsi.org/brom_info/genera.html |title=Bromeliad Info - Genera Etymology<!-- Bot generated title --> |access-date=2007-02-18 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070203011214/http://www.bsi.org/brom_info/genera.html |archive-date=2007-02-03 |url-status=dead }}</ref> It is related to the [[genus]] ''[[Vriesea]]'' in the subfamily [[Tillandsioideae]].
